Excited starting this week to use this multimedia pairing, of the film Fruitvale Station and the @blackishabc episode "Hope," in my FYE course where we've been talking representations of #BlackLivesMatter all semester.

https://t.co/QetMBmIshY

Today, @Sen_JoeManchin reminds us again why he's precisely the wrong kind of politician for our #ClimateCrisis & so much else. Hard not to despair.

Tomorrow, Boston has a chance to elect @wutrain, who is precisely the right kind. She, & my son her volunteer, make sure I won't.
